heading: Bio-silica & silicon.
description: Developing biogenic silica from rice husk for rubber, concrete and industrial applications. We are evaluating green silicon pathways to support India’s materials supply chains.
label: Proposed Silicon · Concept visualization

heading: Compressed biogas.
description: Developing compressed biogas from agricultural residues for transport, industry and city gas networks. Planned digestate recovery adds a circular route for returning nutrients to farmland.
label: Proposed CBG · Concept visualization

heading: Sustainable aviation fuel.
description: Evaluating aviation fuel pathways from non-food biomass. Feasibility studies, feedstock planning and potential technology collaboration guide this future development area.
label: Proposed SAF · Concept visualization

heading: Renewable power.
description: Planning solar and wind power to support future industrial energy needs. Our wider development approach also considers process efficiency and waste-heat recovery.
label: Proposed Renewable Power · Concept visualization
